in_sanskrit.name: Ajmeri
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Ajmeri
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ajmeri एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ajmeri is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the Goddess Ajmeri, who is the goddess of fishermen and is believed to protect those who live near water bodies. She is also known as the goddess of fertility and is worshipped for her blessings of prosperity and wealth.
